import json,os
def solve(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    # find segment row
    seg=None
    for i,row in enumerate(inp):
        nz=[(j,c) for j,c in enumerate(row) if c]
        if len(nz)>=2 and nz[1][1]-nz[0][1]==1 and all(nz[k+1][1]-nz[k][1]==1 for k in range(len(nz)-1)):
            seg=(i,nz); break
    r0,nz=seg
    # find single cells (anchors) off segment
    anchors={}
    for i,row in enumerate(inp):
        if i==r0: continue
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c: anchors[c]=(i,j)
    cols=[j for j,c in nz]; colors=[c for j,c in nz]
    left=colors[0]; mid=colors[len(colors)//2]; right=colors[-1]
    for j,c in nz:
        if c==left:
            ar,ac=anchors[c]
            for i in range(r0,ar+1): out[i][j]=c
            for jj in range(0,ac+1): out[ar][jj]=c
        elif c==right:
            ar,ac=anchors[c]
            for i in range(r0,ar+1): out[i][j]=c
            for jj in range(ac,w): out[ar][jj]=c
        else:
            for i in range(r0,h): out[i][j]=c
    return out

def solve(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    seg=None
    for i,row in enumerate(inp):
        nz=[(j,c) for j,c in enumerate(row) if c]
        if len(nz)>=3 and all(nz[k+1][0]-nz[k][0]==1 for k in range(len(nz)-1)):
            seg=(i,nz); break
    r0,nz=seg
    anchors={}
    for i,row in enumerate(inp):
        if i==r0: continue
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c: anchors[c]=(i,j)
    for j,c in nz:
        if c in anchors:
            ar,ac=anchors[c]
            for i in range(r0,ar+1): out[i][j]=c
            for jj in range(min(ac,j),max(ac,j)+1): out[ar][jj]=c
        else:
            for i in range(r0,h): out[i][j]=c
    return out
